For the first time since 'Operation Sindoor', a Pakistani minister has arrived in India. Pakistan's Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination, Musadik Masood Malik, has reached Delhi. He will lead the Pakistani delegation at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilizational Dialogue Forum, which is being held in New Delhi from November 20 to 22. The event will be inaugurated by Prime Minister Modi. The Congress party has targeted the Modi government over this development.
